bearm: bearm — bosom, lap; hold (accusative singular; on bearm scipes 'into the ship's bosom')
becōm: becuman — came, arrived (3rd singular preterite; the old sense of 'become')
cwæð: cweðan — said, declared (3rd singular preterite; cf. archaic 'quoth')
fram: fram — from, away from (preposition, here following its object: mancynne fram 'from mankind')
fyrst: fyrst — space of time, interval, respite (nominative singular)
gefrægn: gefrignan — (I) heard tell, learned by inquiry (1st singular preterite; the prologue's gefrūnon is its plural)
gegyrwan: gegyrwan — to equip, adorn, make ready (infinitive)
gewāt: gewītan — departed, went (3rd singular preterite; him gewāt 'took himself off')
him: hē — to him, or to them (dative singular or plural of hē)
hwæt: hwæt — what! lo! (interjection calling for attention; also the pronoun 'what')
hwīle: hwīl — while, space of time (accusative singular)
hām: hām — home (tō hām 'homeward'; the ancestor of 'home')
hēold: healdan — held, ruled; kept (to a place) (3rd singular preterite)
manna: mann — of men (genitive plural; manna hwone 'any of men')
mid: mid — with (preposition; here after its object: him mid 'with him')
mægenes: mægen — of the might, force (genitive singular; cf. 'main' in 'might and main')
nō: nō — not at all, by no means (emphatic negative)
nǣnig: nǣnig — no, none, not any (pronoun; ne + ǣnig 'any')
ond: ond — and (the usual spelling of and in this MS)
sceal: sculan — shall, must, ought by nature to (3rd singular present)
scolde: sculan — had to, was obliged to (3rd singular preterite)
scēawedon: scēawian — beheld, examined (3rd plural preterite; the ancestor of 'show')
se: se — the, that (nominative singular masculine; unaccented spelling of sē)
sē: sē — he, that one; the (nominative singular masculine of the demonstrative; sē þe 'he who')
sēlest: sēlest — best (superlative; its comparative sēlla has no positive — 'good' is understood)
sōhte: sēcan — sought (3rd singular preterite; the word is supplied by editors — Klaeber's brackets — where the manuscript lost a verb)
wang: wang — plain, open field (accusative singular; poetic word)
wið: wið — against; with (preposition; wið Gode 'against God')
wolde: willan — would, wished to (3rd singular preterite)
ymb: ymb — after, about, around (preposition; ymb āne niht 'after one night')
ðā: sē/þā — the, those (nominative plural of the demonstrative); as adverb: then
þe: þe — who, which, that (the indeclinable relative particle)
þæs: þæt — for that, of that (genitive singular of the demonstrative: 'comfort for that')
þā: þā — then (adverb); also: those, the (plural demonstrative); who, which (relative)
þāra: sē — of those (genitive plural of the demonstrative)
þē: þe — which, that (relative particle; Klaeber prints þē, emended — the MS has only 'þ')
þēoden: þēoden — lord, chief of a people (accusative singular; from þēod 'people')
